pull.title: chainparams: delete my DNS seed
pull.body: I plan to shut down my DNS seed server in the future (probably after the release of 32.0), so I request it be removed from the master branch already. It has existed for almost 15 years at this point, and isn't getting much maintenance attention from me anymore.
